descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S22 「其他删除控件（之前的记录、化验值、检查发现、Quick Dictation 格子）确认一次，重复的删除控件说出它删的是哪一条」 Other delete controls (previous note, lab value, diagnostic finding, Quick Dictation compartment) ask once, and repeated delete controls name the item they delete

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Every delete asks for confirmation exactly once, in both modes: a medication row, a task (Encounter or Post-Round), an Important Point, and the other one-tap delete controls on the charts — a previou …（UAT TC-24；TFA-94699 AC 6；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Hospital patient seeded with two Important Points, one previous note and a Quick Dictation compartment; Nursing Home resident seeded with two Important Points, one previous note, one lab value and two diagnostic findings

When For each of the other delete controls: tap it once, press Cancel if a confirmation appears, save a checkpoint. On screens with several delete controls of one kind, read their accessible names.

Then Every delete control asks once and Cancel keeps the item (U8, scope Q4). Delete controls in one list have names that say which item they delete (WCAG 2.4.6 / 4.1.2), not several buttons all named 'Delete point' or 'Remove finding'.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U8 (UAT TC-24 'Each delete asks for confirmation once', TFA-94699 AC 6), scope Q4. oracle.mjs: after the first tap and Cancel the item is still there. Names: mustNotContain the generic name exactly, closing quote included ('button "Delete point"', 'button "Remove finding"'), on screens that list two of them; per-item names such as 'Delete task: <text>' pass. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
